description:
Send a bug report, feature request or comment about Krobot to the Kromatic team by email when the user asks you to.

Needs a free Kromatic account. Just call it: if the user is not signed in, their AI app shows the Kromatic sign-in screen and then this same call goes through; do not refuse or ask them to sign in first. If the app cannot show a sign-in screen, the call returns a "Sign in to use feedback" error; tell the user this step needs a free Kromatic account. A copy is sent to the signed-in account's email. Returns a confirmation, or a delivery error.

Next: tell the user it was sent, or report the error. For questions about the content itself, use search_resources instead.

feedback_type.description: The kind of feedback: 'feedback' for general comments, 'feature_request' for new capabilities, 'bug' for issues.
feedback_type.title: Feedback Type

message.description: Your feedback or request. Be as specific as possible.
message.title: Message

sender_email.description: Optional, and ignored for a signed-in caller: the signed-in account's email is used instead, and that is where the copy of the message goes.
sender_email.title: Sender Email
